content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar, Research & Development Office

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Eligibility for the Program Manager post follows Institute norms, not Funding Agency norms. A candidate must meet any one of the four options below as the essential qualification and experience: Ph.D. or equivalent. OR M.Tech./M.S./M.Phil. or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 02 years of post qualification experience in Teaching/Research/Industrial/Design and development/IT/Administration in an organization/Industry of repute. OR B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./M.C.A./LLM./CA/CMA/CS/MBA/Professional qualification or equivalent in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 04 years of post-qualification experience in teaching/research/Industrial/Design and development/IT/Administration in an organization/Industry of repute. OR B.C.A./B.Sc./B.A./B.Com./B.B.A./LLB. or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 08 years of post-qualification experience in teaching/research/Industrial/Design and development/IT/Administration in an organization/Industry of repute. AND the academic record must meet these marks: a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from Graduation onward, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Excellent project management skills. Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi. Knowledge of Gujarati language is a plus. Prior experience working in non-profit or NGO is a plus. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Program Manager gets a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,25,000/- per month. The appointment lasts till 31/12/2027. Renewal will be based on the performance and availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Program Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: Manage the projects and activities of NEEV, including skill development, education, and livelihood verticals. Coordinate with funding agencies, government agencies, and internal and external stakeholders. Look for new funding opportunities and expand the NEEV program with new projects. Responsibilities include fundraising, budgeting, annual planning, overseeing implementation, reporting and compliance management, PR management, impact assessment, stakeholder liaisoning, and team management.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Program Manager
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only through the IIT Gandhinagar project staff recruitment website (recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff), and the last date to apply is 6 November 2026. The notice states that applications sent by email will not be considered. Candidates with questions can email the Principal Investigator, Hari Sai Ganesh, at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed online. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting or appointment, and a higher cutoff level may be used. The institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill the position through this round of selection, without giving any reason.
